title: Conditions of Carriage: Involuntary Denied Boarding Compensation
content:
**Article on denied boarding — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A passenger holding a confirmed ticketed reservation who checked in on time and is denied boarding involuntarily because the flight is oversold is owed denied-boarding compensation on every fare brand.

## Conditions

- Denied-boarding compensation requires a disruption record of type denied boarding on the segment.
- No compensation is owed when the alternate transportation Crestline arranges arrives less than the fare brand's minimum lateness in hours after the original scheduled arrival, or when the passenger volunteered to give up the seat.

## Amount

Otherwise the compensation is:

- **Lower band** — the fare brand's lower-band percent of the one-way segment fare, capped at the lower-band cap, when the alternate transportation arrives at most the domestic lower-band limit in hours late on a domestic flight, or at most the international lower-band limit in hours late on an international flight;
- **Upper band** — the upper-band percent of the one-way segment fare, capped at the upper-band cap, when it arrives later or no alternate transportation is offered.

The amount is paid in cash by default. A Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher is issued only when the passenger chooses it over cash, and its face value is the cash amount increased by the fare brand's voucher uplift percent, rounded to the cent. The passenger's choice of the voucher is the passenger's own statement.

Denied-boarding compensation replaces goodwill for the same disruption and is additional to the rebooking.

## Hypothetical worked cases (scale figures: no compensation below 1 hour; lower band 200 percent capped at 1075 dollars up to 2 hours domestic or 4 hours international; upper band 400 percent capped at 2150 dollars; voucher uplift 25 percent)

| Segment fare | Flight | Alternate arrives late by | Cash | Voucher if chosen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 | Domestic | 50 minutes | None | None |
| 400.00 | Domestic | 1 h 30 min | 800.00 | 1,000.00 |
| 640.00 | Domestic | 2 h (limit counts) | 1,075.00 (200 percent is 1,280.00, capped) | 1,343.75 |
| 300.00 | International | 5 h | 1,200.00 | 1,500.00 |
| 700.00 | International | No alternate offered | 2,150.00 (400 percent is 2,800.00, capped) | 2,687.50 |
